Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000775": The billing API is not the Ember team's service.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000772": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team noticed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it, as it is not their service.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000708" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000521": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000442": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena Fischer.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000301" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000085": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000729": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000733" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder, having transferred from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000695": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export, having switched to the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000750": As of 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000713" [preference]: As of 2025-09-30, the Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000606" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000686" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched from the ledger service to the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000724" [decision]: Decision on 2025-10-07: after INC-2025-023, reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000648": On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the authentication gateway handover doc for Diego.  (about: Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000717": INC-2025-023 affected the indexer, which served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
